title: My Health Buddy — About the Creator copy + global footer copyright updates

requirements.summary: Update About the Creator page to show the exact child-voice copy for Gabriella Gayle with the required bottom copyright line, keeping typography small/calm/child-friendly.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the About the Creator page shows the heading "About the Creator" and the exact paragraphs as provided by the user, including the 💛 character.
The About the Creator page includes a bottom line that reads exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. All rights reserved."
The text on the About the Creator page is styled in a small, calm, child-friendly way (e.g., small font size and gentle contrast consistent with existing app styling).

file_operations.description: Replace placeholder name and existing copy with the exact user-provided child-voice text using "Gabriella Gayle", and set the bottom line to exactly "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. All rights reserved." Keep existing small/calm typography (e.g., text-sm/text-xs, gentle contrast) consistent with the app. Uses shadcn-ui Card/Button for layout and navigation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the app-wide footer copyright line across all screens to the exact 2026 Gabriella Gayle wording, keeping it small/calm/child-friendly.
acceptanceCriteria: Every screen that shows the footer displays exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. My Health Buddy and the Luma character are original creations. All rights reserved."
The footer text remains small and visually calm (consistent with existing footer styling).

file_operations.description: Update the footer copyright text to exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. My Health Buddy and the Luma character are original creations. All rights reserved." Maintain small, calm, child-friendly styling (keep text-xs, gentle opacity/contrast). Uses shadcn-ui Button for the footer action; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure the footer includes an About the Creator link/button on every screen that navigates to the About the Creator page without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: From the footer on each screen, the user can activate an "About the Creator" link/button to reach the About the Creator page.
The About the Creator link/button does not cause errors when used from any screen (including the About the Creator page itself, if shown there).

file_operations.description: Ensure the About Creator navigation handler is provided for the About Creator screen as well (so its footer includes the About the Creator link/button consistently), and wire any updated AboutCreatorPage props accordingly.

Accept and forward an optional onNavigateToAboutCreator prop to ScreenLayout so the footer's "About the Creator" button/link is present on this screen too (it may remain enabled or be safely no-op/disabled without breaking navigation). Uses existing ScreenLayout + shadcn-ui Button/Card; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add/ensure the exact originality sentence appears in the Privacy & Safety page content with small/calm/child-friendly styling.
acceptanceCriteria: The Privacy & Safety page contains the exact sentence: "The Luma character, wording, and design of this app are original and protected."
The added line is visually small and calm (e.g., uses small text styling consistent with other fine-print content).

file_operations.description: Ensure the Privacy & Safety page includes the exact sentence "The Luma character, wording, and design of this app are original and protected." and keep it styled as small/calm fine print (e.g., text-sm or smaller with gentle contrast) consistent with the rest of the app. Uses shadcn-ui Card/Button for page structure; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
